title: fynkel.Volume
description: A post-processing volume (R3a, `docs/renderer.md` § Volumes): the look overrides in `profile` (a `.volume.json`) applied to the frame by how far inside the shape the camera is. Every frame the renderer starts from the engine defaults and blends the enabled volumes over them in `priority` order (ties: scene order), each by `weight` × its shape's factor — 1 inside, falling linearly to 0 at `blend_distance` outside. The project's quality profile stays the ceiling: a volume cannot turn on what the profile has off.

x-fynkel.tooltip: global: everywhere; box and sphere fade out over the blend distance.

size.description: A box's full size in the entity's local units, each `> 0`.

radius.description: A sphere's radius in the entity's local units, `> 0`.

blend_distance.description: Metres outside the shape over which the volume fades out, `>= 0`.

weight.description: How much of the profile applies, `0..=1`.

priority.description: Higher priorities blend over lower ones.

x-fynkel.tooltip: Higher priorities blend over lower ones; ties go by scene order.
